name: Mirelle's
parkingNotes: Parking and entrance are in the back (Argentine Tango Lovers).
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot, restroom and seating.
hours: Tue tango night 6-10 PM; Thu dinner 5-10 PM and salsa night 7 PM-12 AM; Fri dinner 5-10 PM; Sat call for reservations; Sun brunch 1-6 PM; private events daily
description: A Haitian and Caribbean restaurant and catering hall on Post Avenue in Westbury, with a ballroom and an outdoor courtyard. It hosts a weekly Argentine tango night on Tuesdays, a salsa night, and Sunday brunch.

photos.alt: The cream-colored Mirelle's building on Post Avenue with a Mirelle's sign, evergreen trees and red shrubs along a low wall
Mirelle's ballroom set for a party, with round tables, gold chair covers, candles and a chandelier under purple lighting
Mirelle's outdoor courtyard with palm plants, round tables with pastel tablecloths and silver chairs on a brick patio

evidence.note: Restaurant's home page: restaurant and catering hall at 170 Post Ave, Westbury NY 11590, reservations 516-338-4933; weekly schedule lists a Tango Dance night, a Salsa Dance night (7 PM-12 AM) and Sunday brunch.
Contact page repeats the address and phone and links to the Facebook page.
Google Maps lists Mirelle's Restaurant (Haitian restaurant) at 170 Post Ave, Westbury, NY 11590, phone (516) 338-4933, website mirellesrestaurant.com.
Argentine Tango Lovers of Long Island hold Tango Tuesdays (and a monthly milonga) at Mirelle's in Westbury.

reviewNotes: Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours come from the home page's weekly schedule, which is laid out in columns: Tuesday = tango 6-10 PM, Thursday = dinner 5-10 PM plus salsa 7 PM-12 AM, Friday = dinner 5-10 PM. The column reading for salsa (Thursday vs Friday) is our best reading of the layout; please confirm with the venue. The tango group's own listing says Tuesdays run 7-10:30 PM. The contact page lists a personal-looking Yahoo email and a second (516) 578 number; we left both out. The site's Instagram link goes to a personal account named after the owner (instagram.com/mireillelaguerre), so we did not record it as the venue's Instagram. No logo on the site (the header image is a photo of the building), so logo is empty. Facebook page is linked from the site but needs a login to view.
